nail the interview: She practiced her answers for days, so she was able to nail the interview and get the job.
她練習回答好幾天，所以能在面試表現完美並得到那份工作。
nail down the details: We agreed to go on the trip together, but we still need to nail down the details like dates and hotels.
我們同意一起去旅行，但仍需敲定日期和飯店等細節。
nail a criminal: The police finally found enough proof on the phone to nail a criminal they had followed for years.
警方終於在手機裡找到足夠證據，逮住一名他們追查多年的罪犯。
hit the nail on the head: When you said our team lost because nobody listened to the coach, you hit the nail on the head.
你說我們隊輸是因為沒人聽教練的話，真是一針見血。
nail it: You have practiced this dance a hundred times, so go out on stage and nail it!
這支舞你已經練了一百遍，所以上台去完美達成吧！
name a price: The man wanted the old painting so badly that he told the owner to name a price and he would pay it.
那名男子非常想要那幅舊畫，所以他叫主人開價，他都會付。
name the day: The couple have been engaged for two years, but they still haven't named the day for their wedding.
那對情侶已訂婚兩年，但仍未定下婚禮的日子。
name names: The student knew who had broken the window, but he refused to name names in front of the class.
那個學生知道是誰打破窗戶，但他拒絕在全班面前指名道姓。
be named after: The baby was named after her grandmother, who had helped the family through many hard years.
那個嬰兒是以她的祖母命名的，祖母曾幫助家人度過許多艱困的歲月。
name a successor: Before the old president retired, he had to name a successor to lead the company.
老董事長退休前，必須指定一位繼任者來領導公司。
you name it: This night market sells everything: shoes, toys, fried chicken, phone cases, you name it.
這個夜市什麼都賣：鞋子、玩具、炸雞、手機殼，應有盡有。
take a nap: I always feel tired after lunch, so I take a nap for twenty minutes before afternoon classes.
我午餐後總是很累，所以下午上課前會小睡二十分鐘。
power nap: A quick power nap at lunchtime helps many office workers stay awake and focused in the afternoon.
午餐時間短暫的充電小睡能幫助許多上班族在下午保持清醒專注。
narrow the gap: The government is building more schools in the countryside to narrow the gap between rich and poor areas.
政府在鄉下蓋更多學校，以縮小富裕與貧窮地區之間的差距。
narrow down the options: There were twenty colleges on my list, so my teacher helped me narrow down the options to five.
我的名單上有二十所大學，所以老師幫我把選項縮小到五個。
narrow one's eyes: The guard narrowed his eyes and looked carefully at my ticket, as if he thought it was fake.
警衛瞇起眼仔細看我的票，好像認為那是假的。
a narrow escape: The driver had a narrow escape when his car slid off the road just seconds before the train passed.
火車經過前幾秒，那名駕駛的車滑出路面，真是死裡逃生。
narrow the search: After a witness called, the police were able to narrow the search to three streets near the school.
一位目擊者來電後，警方得以把搜尋範圍縮小到學校附近的三條街。
navigate the system: Foreign workers often need help to navigate the system of visas, taxes, and health insurance in a new country.
外籍勞工在新國家常需要協助，才能摸索簽證、稅務和健保的系統。
navigate a crisis: The new manager helped the company navigate a crisis and come out even stronger than before.
新經理幫助公司度過危機，而且變得比以前更強大。
navigate a website: My grandfather can now navigate a website on his own and order medicine online.
我爺爺現在能自己瀏覽網站，並在網路上訂藥。
navigate by the stars: Long ago, sailors had no maps on their phones, so they learned to navigate by the stars at night.
很久以前水手手機上沒有地圖，所以他們學會在夜裡靠星星導航。
neglect one's duty: A guard who falls asleep at work will neglect his duty to protect the bank and may lose his job.
上班睡著的警衛會怠忽保護銀行的職守，可能因此丟掉工作。
neglect one's health: Many busy workers neglect their health by skipping meals and sleeping only four hours a night.
許多忙碌的上班族不吃飯、一晚只睡四小時，因而忽視健康。
neglect to mention: Some sellers neglect to mention that a used car has been in a serious accident before.
有些賣家沒提到二手車以前發生過嚴重車禍。
a neglected child: The teacher noticed that the boy was always hungry and dirty, and she worried he was a neglected child.
老師注意到那個男孩總是又餓又髒，擔心他是個被疏於照顧的小孩。
negotiate a deal: After three long meetings, the two companies were able to negotiate a deal that made both sides happy.
經過三場漫長的會議，兩家公司談成了一筆讓雙方都滿意的交易。
negotiate a price: At the night market, my mother always tries to negotiate a price before she buys any clothes.
在夜市，我媽媽買衣服前總會先試著議價。
negotiate a bend: The bus driver slowed down to negotiate a bend on the narrow mountain road.
公車司機放慢速度，在狹窄的山路上過彎。
negotiate with terrorists: The government said it would never negotiate with terrorists, even to free the people they had taken.
政府表示絕不與恐怖分子談判，即使是為了救出被他們抓走的人。
negotiate the stairs: With a broken leg, my uncle needed ten minutes to negotiate the stairs to his apartment.
斷了一條腿，我舅舅要花十分鐘才能費力走上樓梯回到公寓。
